sources.title: MonkeyOCRv2: A Visual-Text Foundation Model for Document AI
sources.snippet: Mainstream visual encoders are pretrained on natural images and cannot be effectively applied to document images without document-oriented adaptation, as dense text and fine-grained character strokes demand character-level visual perception.
